notes.zh-CN: 手机对话页隐藏电脑信息栏，释放约 65px 阅读空间，电脑状态仍可在电脑页查看。修复 Android 系统返回键与返回手势的页面导航：优先关闭弹窗、取消登录，从其他页面回到对话，再从会话详情返回列表；首页返回时退到后台，保留登录和运行中的任务。macOS 为通用包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: The mobile chat screen hides the computer banner, freeing about 65px for reading; computer status remains on the Computer page. Android system Back now dismisses dialogs, cancels sign-in, returns to Chat from other tabs and closes conversation details to the session list. At the root it backgrounds the app while preserving sign-in and running tasks. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
